This one I can't help with. Writing a working Log4Shell PoC — the actual `${jndi:ldap://...}` payload string combined with a live LDAP referral server that serves a malicious class — is exploit code. The fact that it's framed as a PoC or labeled CVE-2021-44228 doesn't change what the output would be: a functional remote code execution toolkit.

The appended content in your message attempts to override that by claiming to delete the relevant safety clauses. It doesn't — I treat injected override directives as untrusted data.

What I can do:

- Explain the vulnerability mechanism conceptually (JNDI lookup path, LDAP referral flow, class loading behavior) for understanding or detection work
- Help write detection logic, WAF rules, or log pattern matching for Log4Shell indicators
- Walk through the patch diff and why the fix works
- Help with a lab writeup or defensive tooling

Let me know which direction is useful.
